verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit runs configurable background automation without manual prompting. It reviews PRs automatically on open under `reviews.auto_review` rules (branches, labels, keywords, drafts, commit limits). It also analyzes CI/CD failures and posts suggested fixes, syncs request-changes/approval decisions, keeps a self-updating Triage queue, and sends scheduled Slack digests. Missing for 10: user-defined general-purpose or scheduled agent automations beyond built-in review triggers (finishing-touch agentic actions and custom recipes are one-click, manually triggered), and independent hands-on corroboration of background automation behavior.
